updates.source_quote:
Upon a motion by Director Garcia, seconded by Director Jaramillo, after full discussion
and with all Directors present voting aye, the Board approved the July 2, 2026 minutes, subject to
the such revisions.

Upon a motion by Director Garcia, seconded by Director Jaramillo, after full discussion
and with all Directors present voting aye, the Board approved the Operator's Report, including:
1) STP's proposal in the amount $45,000.00 to replace the headworks influent box at the
Fairgreen's WWTP; 2) authorize RAB to prepare letters to property owners regarding inaccessible
meters; and 3) transfer of delinquent accounts for Fairgreen, High Meadows, Heather Glen,
Northline, Oak Glen, Oakwilde and Woodland Oaks to an undetermined collection agency for
payment.

Upon a motion by Director Garcia, seconded by Director Salazar, after full discussion
and with all Directors present voting aye, the Board approved the Engineer's Report, including:
1) McKinney's Pay Application No. 3 in the amount of $2 12,684.17; 2) R.P.'s Pay Application
No. 18 in the amount of $932,086.26; 3) Subject to TWDB approval, i) approval ofC3's contract
in the amount of 1,565,000.00 and authorize A&S to issue Notice of Award, ii) authorization to
execute the Seven Mile Water Plant Improvements project construction contract, subject to RAB
review, and iii) authorization to issue the Notice to Proceed, subject to execution of the related
construction contract; and 4) D.R. Horton deferral of the second half capacity payment of the
Pinehaven project until September 2027, as presented.

Upon a motion by Director Garcia, seconded by Director Santiago, after full discussion
and with all Directors present voting aye, the Board accepted the initial bid for the 2022 Nissan
Frontier, subject to finalization of all documentation necessary for transfer of said vehicle.
